provenance.encodes: Oman legislation convention: Royal Decree No. N/YYYY (WIPO Lex: Law on Civil and Commercial Procedure promulgated by Royal Decree No. 29/2002)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/legislation/details/22430 and decree.om entries for the Royal Decree No. N/YYYY form.

positive.text: See Royal Decree 6/2020 and Royal Decree No. (42/2013).

negative: The Royal Decree was issued in 2002.
The Royal Decree 2002 archive is closed.

note: Bare 'Royal Decree N/YYYY', the usual Omani form, but the same shape names Spanish (Real Decreto), Moroccan and Jordanian decrees, so it starts at 0.5 confidence and runs below foreign.om.royal_decree (priority 59). Use --exclude rule:foreign.om.royal_decree.bare outside Omani matter.
